label: HOW I WORK
block2: I work below the surface — where the decisions that matter actually get made.I listen at a level most conversations don't reach. I ask the question nobody else asked. I stay in the discomfort instead of resolving it too quickly. And I hold you steady while holding you accountable.This is not coaching that adds more to your thinking. It's coaching that helps you hear what's been trying to get through and takes you somewhere you couldn't have gone alone.
